goal: Make the durable continuation decision safe and independently testable.
acceptance: An active command or write is never interrupted, including when an earlier ResultReceipt exists.
Blank output with durable receipts requests synthesis only and never reruns completed work.
A genuinely inactive authorized step emits exactly one idempotent original-input delivery request.
The delivery packet can be read from durable state; it is not reconstructed from chat prose.
done_definition: SUBMITTED only; verifier reruns all focused F05/F07/continuation tests.
